question: Looking at the 5:30 to 6:00 pm (AEST) half-hour in Queensland on 6 August 2026: what POE50 operational demand did the most recent forecast run issued before that half-hour predict, and how close did actual operational demand come to it?

shown_answer.headline: For QLD1 half-hour ending 2026-08-06 18:00 AEST, the run PUBLIC_FORECAST_OPERATIONAL_DEMAND_HH_202608061800_20260806173222 predicted POE50 = 7598.0 MW and actual operational demand was 7608.0 MW (error −10.0 MW, −0.13%).
summary: The forecast run PUBLIC_FORECAST_OPERATIONAL_DEMAND_HH_202608061800_20260806173222 (issued 2026-08-06T07:27:01Z) predicted POE50 = 7598.0 MW for 2026-08-06 18:00 AEST.
The measured operational demand for the interval ending 2026-08-06 18:00 AEST was 7608.0 MW.
The forecast error (POE50 − actual) was −10.0 MW (percentage error −0.13).
The run's POE10 was 7723.0 MW and POE90 was 7473.0 MW; the actual was reported as within the POE90–POE10 band.
The mean absolute error reported for this run's comparison was 10.0 MW (MAE).

possible_explanations.statement: The small negative error (−10.0 MW) may reflect short-term variability in demand between the forecast issuance and the interval ending 2026-08-06T08:00:00Z; the run was issued at 2026-08-06T07:27:01Z.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare higher-frequency (five-minute) dispatch TOTALDEMAND and 30-minute operational demand for QLD1 around 2026-08-06T08:00:00Z and the forecast issuance time 2026-08-06T07:27:01Z.

possible_explanations.statement: The forecast model's typical uncertainty might produce errors of this magnitude; comparing this pair to the run's MAE could show whether it is typical.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare POE50 − actual errors over the paired half-hour(s) returned by the forecast-versus-actual comparison and compare the pair at 2026-08-06T08:00:00Z to the MAE.

published_findings.statement: An AEMO market notice for QLD1 [c1] says: “NON-CONFORMANCE Region QLD1 Friday, 7 August 2026.”

uncertainties: The forecast-versus-actual comparison returned only one paired target for this run; other half-hours in the 24-target window had no matching pair under the run selection used.
Higher-resolution demand or participant data needed to attribute the small error to specific short-term changes.
